about_the_game:
About The Game

AsTroops is a top-down roguelike arcade game set in a world where Earth is under siege by a massive alien mothership and its ruthless army. You are the commander of humanity’s last hope: self-guided kamikaze rockets designed to break through enemy lines and destroy the blockade.

Control your rocket in real-time, action-packed missions. Navigate through deadly space filled with alien ships, lock onto your targets, and crash with explosive precision. Every mission is unique, demanding quick reflexes and smart decisions.

But the war isn’t just about rockets. Between missions, earn money through your idle economy system. Invest in science to unlock new rocket parts — advanced engines, reinforced bodies, powerful warheads, and precision targeting systems await you.

Equip your modular spacecraft with weapons of your choice. Customize its functions and abilities to match your playstyle — the decision is yours.

Your mission is clear: weaken the mothership’s control by destroying alien satellites. Every victory makes you stronger, every failure teaches you something new.

Astroops combines real-time action, idle strategy, and modular design into a fast-paced space warfare experience. How long can you survive? Can you break the blockade?
